column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 to MITRE ATT&CK Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Mappings between ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS LinkML classes/Annex A controls and MITRE ATT&CK concepts (Mitigations, Tactics, and Techniques). Class-level anchors link Risk and SecurityIncidentCategory to ATT&CK threat-modelling concepts. Per-control rows use skos:relatedMatch (default) to link Annex A technological controls to ATT&CK Mitigation entries (e.g., M1041 Encrypt Sensitive Information). Predicate choice - relatedMatch because Annex A controls are objectives whereas ATT&CK mitigations are tactical countermeasures; closeMatch where alignment is direct (e.g., MFA, encryption).
